method: Videos: official uploads by the source (lab or conference channel), segment downloaded with yt-dlp at ≤1080p H.264 and trimmed with ffmpeg; not committed (scripts/fetch-evidence.sh rebuilds them from the links). Pages: one headless Chrome, no profile, no login, no paywall bypass, cookie banners rejected; crop = the passage, chart or table that carries the claim; sticky site bars hidden locally for mid-page crops; nothing on the page edited. PDF sources: one page region rendered with PyMuPDF. Sites that answered with a bot block were skipped, not evaded.
